molecule.canonicalization: No MolToSmiles rewrite. Fingerprint consumes original supplied full molecular graph.
molecule.stereochemistry: Use only supplied assigned stereochemistry; unspecified centers remain unspecified, never imputed.

protein.AAC_denominator: entire effective prefix length, including unknown positions
protein.dipeptide_denominator: entire effective prefix length minus one; if prefix length 1, all 400 values are zero
protein.unknown_characters: X and any nonalphabet character contribute no canonical count, remain in length denominators, and break adjacent pairs. No deletion, compression, uppercase conversion or imputation.
protein.length_scalar: raw EFFECTIVE PREFIX length, not full-reference length; max1000, no learned scaling

y_in_feature_cache: absent; actual labels are never read in feature preparation
target_scope: provided reference sequence view; not certification of actual assay construct
